avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces morphine plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative antidepressant if mood support needed

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression increases sedation, respiratory depression risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue valerian or reduce morphine dose with close monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates CNS depression and increases hepatotoxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; substitute with non-hepatotoxic anxiolytics if needed

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase morphine levels and side effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased sedation or constipation; adjust dose if necessary

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly elevate morphine concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; inform provider if using for liver support

caution_supplements.name: Goldenseal
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4/2D6 inhibition may increase morphine levels
caution_supplements.action: Limit duration of use; monitor for opioid-related adverse effects

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases morphine bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit completely; no safe threshold exists

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay morphine absorption and peak levels; variable effect depending on formulation
caution_foods.action: Take immediate-release morphine on empty stomach; note timing of extended-release doses

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression increases sedation and respiratory depression risk
caution_foods.action: Minimize alcohol consumption; educate patient on cumulative depressant effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and constipation, particularly when combining with CNS depressants or CYP enzyme inhibitors. Counsel patients to maintain consistent dietary habits and avoid abrupt changes in supplement use without consulting provider.
